- Connect the electrical connections to the heater plugs control unit then place it in its housing and secure it using the nut.

- Connect the electrical connections to the heater plugs control unit.

- Place the electrical wiring in position and fasten it to the bands.

- Connect the earth lead and tighten the nut.

- Connect the electrical connection to the air conditioning system multi-stage pressure switch.

- Connect the air conditioning compressor electrical connection.
